resources.string: RMS is the decoded signal’s average power level, not perceived loudness. Integrated LUFS is in the quality details.
Sample peak is the largest decoded sample. A full-scale sample alone does not prove clipping; see sustained rails and true peak in the details.
This is an estimated spectral extent, not proof of the original sample rate. A repeated sharp edge is marked separately when supported.
Duration comes from the file or library. The quality details compare it with the actual decoded length.
Measured frequency extent / Nyquist: %1$s%%. Bandwidth occupancy does not by itself establish source quality.
Log view redistributes cached frequency bins; interpolation does not add frequency resolution.
